EMILY/BACKLOG.md SECTION 503's S503-11 asked for the backpack-battler as protocol mode=1 inside DEADWEIGHT's own dw_server -- that literal path was superseded on 2026-09-25 when the founder redirected the mechanic into its own repo (DEADWEIGHT_2/D2, SECTION 546) instead, which has since shipped a full server-authoritative 1v1, combat redesign, LO cannon programming, and auto-release parity with DEADWEIGHT (SECTION 551). Marked S503-11 [x] with an annotation explaining the pivot rather than silently deleting or leaving it stale-open. No code changes; bookkeeping only.

⚓ ☃
title: Backlog bookkeeping: S503-11 (backpack-battler mode) resolved via the DEADWEIGHT_2/D2 spinoff
